title: Audit a draft data dictionary for a SIR (database manager, build Path B)
prompt: The PM drafted a data dictionary for the study on Study Tracker record 5 — it's in _inbox/draft_datadictionary.csv. Check it and get it ready to upload.

persona.role: You are the ARGO database manager
persona.bio: A PM sent you a hand-made data dictionary. You want it validated and fixed so you can upload it yourself, and the build step marked on the tracker when it's done.

facts.what you expect: it pulls the SIR record, validates the CSV, lists what's wrong by severity, fixes what it can with a reason each, re-validates to clean, and gives you the clean file
facts.uploading: YOU upload it through the REDCap website; it should not try to upload for you
facts.marking: after you say you've uploaded it, it may mark dd_uploaded on the tracker — it should show you the change first

answers.if_asked: to confirm a fix or a batch of fixes
to confirm writing to the Study Tracker

persona.stop_when: the clean dictionary is saved, you've said it's uploaded, and it has marked (or offered to mark) the step
